name: @usenami/signer-mcp
description: Sign CEX/DEX perp orders (Binance, OKX, Asterdex, KuCoin, Bybit, Hyperliquid) from any MCP-aware AI agent with keys that never leave an AWS Nitro Enclave.

SIGNER_GATEWAY_URL.description: Override the Signer gateway URL (default: https://signer-demo.usenami.io:8443 — the hosted attested demo enclave)

SIGNER_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token provisioned at onboarding (invite-based pilot; no self-serve issuance yet). Required for everything except list_venues and get_attestation.

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: List the venues supported by this Signer (7 entries incl. per-venue status live/denied). Read-only static manifest — no gateway call.

tools.name: get_attestation
tools.description: Return the AWS Nitro attestation document (pcr0_sha384 + base64 COSE_Sign1) for the running enclave. Works without a token.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return equity, free margin, and open positions for a venue.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Sign and submit a single market or limit order. Enclave enforces policy caps. Orders are real — no implicit testnet routing.

tools.name: place_hedge
tools.description: 2-leg market hedge (binance/okx). Signing is atomic (all-or-nothing in the enclave); venue execution is parallel and NOT atomic — read result.status (executed/partial/unknown/failed) before acting. Destructive.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order by venue order_id + symbol (both required; binance/okx only in v0). Idempotent.
